differences.detail: The implementation is vertically centered slightly lower than the reference.
The implementation background is slightly cooler than the reference wash.
Dynamic Stripe fields make the implementation end slightly higher on mobile.
The Payment Element card height varies with Stripe's selected payment method.

suggestions: Optionally nudge the desktop checkout shell upward.
Optionally tune the outer background toward the reference blue-gray.
Optionally reserve more Payment Element height when a stable visual weight is preferred.
reasoning: The approved 1120px shell, desktop columns, responsive stacking, amount hierarchy, blue CTA, rounded surfaces, dividers, close control, and Stripe footer match the reference. Localized copy and Stripe-rendered payment fields are dynamic and were excluded from the visual mismatch score.
